fields.description: Issue features extensive political coverage of Miami’s city commission run-off election, including a Miami Life poll and editorials urging Northwest section voters to support incumbents H. Leslie Quigg and Perrine Palmer, Jr., and criticizing opponents Leonard K. Thomson and William Wolfarth. Articles argue that consolidation of city and county tax assessment and changes to the water board could raise residential taxes and water rates, and connect the campaign to opposition to the Florida sales tax. Additional content includes local commentary columns, reports on conditions faced by indigent elderly residents and appeals for affordable rooms, discussion of law enforcement actions against pinball machine payoffs, and a letter noting Cuban newspaper "Oriente" reprinting Miami Life material about Cuban Senator Jose Aleman.
